title: Report No. 121/18, Case 10.573: José Isabel Salas Galindo et al. (Panama v. United States)
publisher_or_archive: Organization of American States, Washington D.C.
summary: Landmark human rights determination by the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights holding the United States accountable for human rights violations and civilian casualties resulting from the December 1989 military invasion of Panama (Operation Just Cause), urging the US government to provide full financial and moral reparations to victims and their surviving families.
